:::{#cor-linear-is-affine}
#### Every linear map is affine

Every linear map $f : \reals^p \to \reals^m$ (@def-linear-map)
is an affine map (@def-affine-map) with offset $\vzero$.

:::

::: proof

If $f$ is linear, @thm-linear-map-matrix gives a matrix $\matr{A}$
with

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(\vx) &= \matr{A}\vx \\
&= \matr{A}\vx + \vzero,
\end{aligned}
$$

which is @def-affine-map with $\vec{b} = \vzero$.

:::
